Bowstring Boulevard.name: Bowstring Boulevard
Bowstring Boulevard.description: The user's signature move: they stretch the air across a whole street into layer on layer of elastic sheets and charge them with their Quirk until they hum, then let go. The snap slams down the street: everyone in front takes massive force damage and is thrown off their feet, and cars, barricades and cover are shoved aside; afterward the user cannot make a patch until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.
